description: List Markdown checkbox tasks as compact structured rows (path, line, state, text, nearest heading) — vault-wide or scoped by note, folder, tag, or modified time. Defaults to open tasks. Custom markers like "/" are single-char states. Rows feed straight into update_task; use this instead of searching for "- [ ]" or reading whole notes.

folder.description: Restrict to a vault-relative folder prefix.

modifiedAfter.description: Only tasks in notes modified at or after this ISO 8601 date/time.

path.description: Vault-relative path to a single note. Omit to search the whole vault.

anyOf.description: open = "- [ ]" (default); done = "- [x]" or "- [X]"; any = every task.
A single custom marker character, e.g. "/" or "-".

state.description: Which tasks to return. Default: open.

tag.description: Restrict to notes with this tag. # optional, case-insensitive; nested child tags match ("project" matches project/alpha).

name: list_tasks
